results.rationale: u0000 imports PEER_VERSION_EPOCH_2_0 solely to support u0001 adding network_epoch to the block-limit test config (one intent); u0002 independently sets microblock_attempt_time_ms in a different microblock test, a distinct action-object.
u0000 exposes the isList helper from core exports; u0001 adds a null-guard on parent in markPasteRule, an unrelated bug fix in a different package.

u0000-u0001 add a --check flag to deno fmt and u0002-u0003 are its supporting flag-parsing tests (single intent); u0004 fixes the expected WILDCARD path in wasm_unreachable.out, an unrelated deliberate test-expectation fix.

u0000 restructures the circle.yml template to put the cache job in its own workflow; u0001 makes the mocha test glob use the templated _ext instead of hardcoded ts — independent template fixes with different objects.

u0000 adds display:flex to fix CodeEditor textarea/pre layout; u0001 deletes a leftover debug console.log from the koa-auth test — a deliberate cleanup with a different action-object, not mere formatting.

u0000 rewrites _Merge via Compute<O & Omit<...>> and u0001 adjusts the Merge alias accordingly since Omit moved inside _Merge — one refactor intent; u0002 independently tightens Strict's constraint from any to object.

u0000 adds an icon mapping for the lib extension; u0001 applies Rust field-init shorthand in the unrelated xattr module — a standalone deliberate idiomatic cleanup (code change, not whitespace), so its own small intent rather than background.
u0000 adds overflow:auto to the simulator host style; u0001 exposes an availableActions getter on ComponentMeta in the shell package — unrelated modules and different action-objects.

u0000 and u0002 both extend pystd type stubs (platform.d.er and sys.d.er) with missing Python API declarations — same action and object family, one intent; u0001 is an unrelated language-server fix removing stale mod_cache entries in get_checker.

u0000 fixes the toRoundedUnit call in core to pass the TDinero type parameter; u0001 rewords an unrelated test description in the dinero.js package — the test change does not verify the type-parameter fix, so they are separate intents.
u0000 adds @mousedown.stop on the time-picker slot to stop event propagation; u0001 switches the popper lodash mock from genMockFromModule to requireActual — independent fixes in unrelated packages.

u0000-u0001 together stop relying on this.state in view.js (drop the init, schedule via setState({})) — one intent; u0002-u0003 replace useMemo with useRef for local store persistence in store.js (the import change supports the body change) — a second intent.

u0000 adds the set_secret API method to the SDK; although the file is gen.rs, this change is itself the semantic delivery rather than a mechanical byproduct of another change, so foreground. u0001-u0002 add the same with_exec echo step to both iss_30 tests — a separate intent unrelated to secrets.

u0000 adds a COBOL sample file and u0002 registers it via samplePath in languages.ts — one intent; u0001 marks renderer-path as private in its package.json, an independent packaging decision not required by the sample addition.
u0000 adds a complete Tamil (ta) i18n translation file; u0001 raises the rowsVisibleChanged event in Grid.js core — unrelated additions with different objects.

u0000 fixes the crossterm cursor coordinate off-by-one by dropping the +1 offsets; u0001 improves the drop-time error log to include the actual error value — independent changes to different subsystems.

u0000-u0001 both migrate space-key tests from KeySpace to the KeyRunes representation — one intent; u0002 fixes options_test error messages to print p.input instead of p.output, a separate copy-paste bug fix.
u0000 allows filtering admin orders by display_id in the query builder; u0001 adds a generic Writable<T> utility type in common.ts that the query change does not use — independent intents.
u0000 fixes a frontend method call (tree -> groupTree) in Group.vue; u0001 adds SQL query logging in the backend DataSetTableService — unrelated frontend fix vs backend logging addition.

u0000 adds sbom/provenance options and an anchore scan step to the docker workflow; u0001 corrects the date in a commit-preprocessor test fixture — a deliberate expectation fix unrelated to the docker CI change.
